method.prompt: Photorealistic dawn close-up in the same narrow alley corner between two dark brick houses at night, snow piled against the walls, a single dim street lamp glowing, the same cold dawn, moments later, her small face with a peaceful smile, cheeks rosy, one burnt match still between her fingers. a barefoot girl of about nine with reddish-gold hair under a patched gray coat, clutching a bundle of matchboxes rests forever warm in the vision. Static reverent close-up. Morning stillness, faint thaw drip.
